# draht

> draht is an open source (MIT) AI coding agent for the terminal, published on npm as @draht/coding-agent. It is a fork of the pi coding agent by Mario Zechner.

- Run: `npx @draht/coding-agent`, or `npm install -g @draht/coding-agent` then `draht`
- Auth: API keys (e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) or `/login` with Claude Pro/Max, ChatGPT Plus/Pro (Codex), GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, Antigravity
- Default tools: read, write, edit, bash
- Features: duet mode, Polyphase workflows, session tree, MCP servers, extensions, skills, prompt templates, themes, SDK and RPC mode
- License: MIT
